# Warp v0.1.2

Maintenance release for Warp.

## Fixes

- Add `ServeHTTPOnListener` to serve the HTTP inspector on a caller-owned listener without rebinding the TCP port. Warp takes ownership only after a successful start; failed starts leave listener cleanup to the caller.
- Keep the existing address-based `ServeHTTP` APIs and standalone demo behavior unchanged.

## Testing

- Add listener ownership and HTTP health-probe regression tests.
- Run the complete Go, race, lint, vulnerability, portability, and cue-tty Warp E2E matrices.
